mission: HEADROOM PHASE-3 - NUMERIC GROUNDING VERIFICATION REMEDIATION (Fix B)
section: §4/§5/§6/§7/§8 - what Fix B inventories, how it reads a figure, and what may ground one
sourceQuotationFields: SourceProvenance.excerpt (on rules, conditions, exceptions, definitions and every expression node)

NON_SEMANTIC_FIELD: every closed enum (posture, ruleType, action, covenantFamily, conditionType, relationshipType, entityScope tags)
STRUCTURED numeric literals (already inventoried by ir-inventory.ts - re-reading them here would double-report)

CURRENCY_AMOUNT: 150 million (no currency stated - comparable on magnitude, never against a DIFFERENT stated currency)

neverExtracted: any bare figure with no currency, percent, ratio or unit marker
normalizedEquivalenceRules: 10% == 10.0% (both canonicalize to the fraction 0.1, matching IRPercentLiteral and the source inventory)
$150 million == $150,000,000 (exact integer scaling via amount-parser.ts - never 0.15 * 1e9 in binary floating point)

30 days == thirty days == ninety (90)-style parenthetical numerals (EVIDENCE side only - a spelled number is never read as an assertion out of IR prose, so the table can ground a figure but can never manufacture a finding)
equivalencesDeliberatelyRefused: a percentage never matches a ratio
a stated USD figure never matches the same magnitude stated in EUR or GBP

admitted: the candidate's own operative source window (PRIMARY_LOCAL)
every retrieved source retrieved-evidence.ts independently re-resolved, hash-checked and authenticated (authenticated definitions and authenticated provisions alike)
refused: any context-bundle excerpt the verifier could not authenticate
authenticatedEvidenceUniverse.note: This is exactly the universe the STRUCTURED numeric path already uses. Fix B widened what is compared; it widened nothing about what counts as evidence.

groundingOutcomes.GROUNDED_OPERATIVE: the figure appears verbatim in the candidate's own anchor
groundingOutcomes.GROUNDED_CONTEXT: the figure appears verbatim in authenticated retrieved evidence
groundingOutcomes.NORMALIZED_EQUIVALENT: same canonical value, different rendering - groundedIn still records OPERATIVE vs CONTEXT
groundingOutcomes.UNGROUNDED: no authenticated source figure supports it -> an IR_ONLY reconciliation item
groundingOutcomes.AMBIGUOUS: the assertion's own magnitude could not be read safely - review required, never guessed, never compared

findingMapping.SOURCE_QUOTATION_FIELD + UNGROUNDED: PROVENANCE_MISMATCH (existing type - a fabricated excerpt is a provenance defect, not a meaning defect)
findingMapping.severity: MATERIAL when any rule/definition in the candidate claims COMPLETE sufficiency, UNCERTAIN otherwise - so a COMPLETE rule cannot hide the defect; either way the status floor is REVIEW_REQUIRED
findingMapping.downgradeImmunity: verify.ts's AMBIGUOUS-downgrade path was explicitly scoped to exclude numeric-grounding items, so an unread magnitude cannot be silently downgraded to NON_MATERIAL

noMutation: reconciliation.ts's numeric-assertion items carry no sourceItem and never enter claimedIrItemIds, so a prose figure can never account for a source figure and a source figure can never claim a prose one. The IR value itself is never deleted, nulled or rewritten (mission §8).
